subject: Alchemica security sync — CAIQ & SIG evidence planning
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@alchemica.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@alchemica.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG / CAIQ kickoff and evidence intake

Hi Jonas and Marissa,

Thanks for the quick responses last week. Wed like to kick off a SIG/CAIQ intake for Alchemica as part of our vendor review. High-level asks:

- 30-45m sync to walk through Redwoodds CAIQ mapping, SOC 2 summary, and where youd expect us to pull samples (logs, IAM config, config backups).
- A short artifacts list we can use to request from our security team (log retention windows, sample queries, export formats).

Were available Thursday (6/17) 10-11am PT or Friday (6/18) 10-11am PT. If those dont work, propose two alternate slots.

I attached our internal SIG template to show the question matrix we use. Can you confirm whether you can provide:

1) SOC 2 report summary or bridge letter
2) CAIQ mapping (CSV/Excel)
3) sample logs (S3 link or stub) and point of contact for exports

Thanks — Ill coordinate calendar invites once we settle on time.

Lena Park
Security Program Manager, Alchemica
[Attachment: alchemica-sig-template.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@alchemica.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ kickoff and evidence intake

Lena,

Appreciate the template — we can do Friday 6/18 10:00am PT. Tentative invite sent to your calendar.

Well bring:
- A one-page SOC 2 summary + list of control owners.
- CAIQ mapping (we have an exported matrix and a pivot weve found useful).
- Attachment list and recommended sample windows for logs (auth, admin, system).

Proposed 30-minute agenda:
1) Quick intros and scope alignment (5m)
2) Walkthrough of CAIQ mapping and where Redwood maps to controls (10m)
3) Evidence handoff expectations and log export mechanics (10m)
4) Next steps & action owners (5m)

Pre-call asks: could you flag the top 10 SIG questions you want prioritized in the session? If theres a particular compliance reviewer joining (Tom?) please loop them into the invite.

Attachments for your review: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, caiq-evidence-matrix.xlsx.

[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf, 820KB)]
[Attachment: caiq-evidence-matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 450KB)]

Jonas Weber
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ kickoff and evidence intake

Thanks — Friday 6/18 10:00am PT works and Ive added Tom (our procurement/security lead). A couple quick clarifications before we meet:

- Log retention: for sampling well need authentication events and admin logs going back 90 days. Can you confirm whether those are available as raw exports or only via query?
- DLP/access: we have two questions on how you handle embedded PII in request logs; will that be something you can cover in 5-7 minutes?

Im attaching a short doc with our prioritized SIG rows so we can hit the highest-risk items first.

Lena
[Attachment: prioritized-sig-rows.docx (docx, 40KB)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@alchemica.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tom Graves <tom.graves@alchemica.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Meeting notes: Alchemica SIG/CAIQ sync (6/18)

Thanks for your time today — notes and next steps below.

Summary:
- Walked through our CAIQ mapping and how Redwood aligns answers to CAIQ control families.
- Confirmed we can provide a SOC 2 summary and a scoped set of exported logs for a 90-day window. Exports are delivered as compressed S3 bundles with a manifest.
- Clarified handling of PII in request logs: request header values are redacted by default in the hosted offering; Dedicated/Private deployments have config knobs and optional token-level masking.

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Jonas: Upload SOC 2 one-page and Bridge Letter stub to shared folder (ETA: 2027-06-19).
- Marissa: Deliver CAIQ spreadsheet with mapping notes and sample evidence links (ETA: 2027-06-21).
- Ben: Coordinate log export run and provide S3 read-only link / manifest for the 90-day window (ETA: 2027-06-22).
- Alchemica (Tom/Lena): Confirm which SIG rows they want in the formal questionnaire turnaround and provide contact for legal/procurement (ETA: 2027-06-21).

Attachments from today: meeting-notes-20270618.txt (this note), sample export manifest format (example shared in Drive).

Meeting transcript highlights (select):
> Tom Graves (Alchemica): "Were primarily concerned with admin-level access and key rotation cadence."
>
> Jonas Weber (Redwood): "Key rotation info and KMS usage is in the CAIQ mapping under A.5 and well flag the evidence sample for rotation artifacts."

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cALCHEMICA-SIG (evidence drop), https://redwood.app/doc/ALC-2027-CAIQ-mapping

Jonas Weber
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: meeting-notes-20270618.txt (txt, 6KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@alchemica.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meeting notes: Alchemica SIG/CAIQ sync (6/18)

Following up to confirm next steps and scheduling the evidence drop window. Well: 

- Open the Drive folder for Alchemica evidence intake on Monday 6/21 at 9:00am PT.
- Ben will post the S3 manifest and a temporary read-only link once the export completes (ETA EOD 6/22).
- Jonas and I will be available for a 45-minute follow-up the week of 6/28 to review any outstanding SIG rows you mark as high priority.

If you need the artifacts earlier please let us know and well prioritize the export run. Thanks again for coordinating — great conversation.

Marissa Cole
Senior Security Solutions, Redwood Inference
